title: Raincoat theme override file
description: A file of token overrides in a theme, at themes/<id>/tokens/<tier>/<name>.tokens.json. It mirrors the base file of the same name and gives new values to tokens that file marks overridable. Types, descriptions, and contrast declarations come from the base; a theme cannot add or remove a token.

$description.description: Optional: why the theme chose this value. The token's own description comes from the base.
